programme.title: Dil Juunglee
programme.desc: Love blossoms between Koroli and Sumit, two people with contrasting personalities, when the latter joins her English class.

programme.title: Turtle
programme.desc: Ramkaran tirelessly churns the dry earth of a village in Rajasthan for water. Meanwhile, the villagers participate in desperate measures to satisfy their thirst.

programme.title: Omerta
programme.desc: Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh, a British terrorist of Pakistani descent, plots the kidnapping and murder of Wall Street Journal journalist Daniel Pearl.

programme.title: Indrajeet
programme.desc: Indrajeet, a retired police officer, sets out to take revenge on his ex-lover's brother and friends for murdering his adopted daughter and son-in-law.

programme.desc: In their misguided pursuit of happiness outside of marriage, three husbands end up in the crosshairs of a man who is like an elder brother to their wives.

programme.desc: A wife embraces her husband's illegitimate son as her own in honour of the other woman's memory. However, as time progresses, this starts to seem like a big mistake.

programme.title: Sandwich
programme.desc: Sher Singh has two wives, Nisha and Sweety, and juggles his time between them. However, when his two wives cross paths, his troubles increase manifold leading to hilarious situations.

programme.title: Kismat Konnection
programme.desc: Raj, an out-of-luck architect, and Priya, an out-of-love social activist, find themselves connected in a strange way by destiny.

programme.title: Anari No. 1
programme.desc: Raja, a waiter, and his girlfriend, Sapna, hatch a plan to kidnap Rahul, a rich man who is Raja's lookalike. But things go awry when Raja gets trapped in his own plan.

programme.title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
programme.desc: In the small-town of Bareilly, a free-spirited Bitti hates that she is being pressured into getting married. But when she reads a book that reflects her life, she sets out to find its author.

programme.title: Mitron
programme.desc: Jai, an easy-going man, is his father's biggest worry as he wants him to get married and become more responsible. However, things change after he meets Avni, an ambitious MBA graduate.

programme.desc: Sanjay, a Rajput, is in love with Aditi, a Jat, and wants to get married. However, they realise that their parents would never allow it, so they come up with a cunning plan to get married.

programme.title: Footfairy
programme.desc: A CBI officer investigates a string of gruesome murders committed by a serial killer with a foot fetish. However, things take an ugly turn when he gets close to catching the killer.

programme.title: Love Hostel
programme.desc: A series of bloodshed, escapes and deception ensue when Jyothi and Ashu elope together and her family hires a ruthless mercenary to kill the couple.

programme.title: Aatma: Feel It Around You

programme.title: Yeh Vada Raha
programme.desc: Vikram's mother rejects Sunita due to her poverty. However, when the couple elopes, a terrible accident separates them, derailing their plans for a future together.

programme.title: Manikarnika: The Queen of Jhansi
programme.desc: After the death of her husband and child, Lakshmibai takes over the throne of Jhansi and defends the kingdom against the tyranny of the East India Company.

programme.title: Henna

programme.title: Hi Papa
programme.desc: A loving father and his young daughter face life-altering changes when his romantic interest weds another man, challenging their bond and reshaping their future together.

programme.title: No Entry
